sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹5L–₹20L referenced in sub-limit table)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if reimbursement under optional Cashless Discount cover
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available as optional discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped (10% of SI, max ₹50k/eye) inbuilt; broader sub-limits optional
sub_limits.note: Inbuilt: Cataract limited to 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver disease etc.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000/₹20,000/₹30,000/₹40,000/₹50,000/₹1L/₹2L/₹3L available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr or 100% at 50%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Available for in-patient hospitalisation only; not for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap (same insured).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided in Annexure I; other procedures meeting day-care definition also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded: asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne diseases, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to in-patient SI. Comfort treatments and OPD excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to in-patient SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to in-patient hospitalisation SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered up to in-patient SI. Cumulative bonus and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for established fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document; applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, no IVF/ART, no dental (unless accident+hosp), no refractive error <7.5D, no external congenital anomalies, no growth hormone therapy

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount, Voluntary Co-pay/Deductible
